Players Committee card image of [[Lando Calrissian (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Smuggler. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may take a character with 'Cloud City' in lore into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may use 1 Force to cancel the game text of a Dark Jedi (except Vader) at same site.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/landocalrissian.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
